title: Documentation + reference-impl 0.8.1 version bump + acceptance-walker scenario
definition_of_done: reference-impl/README.md: the 'Security review' section gains a sentence noting that as of v0.8.1 the security-review step is mechanically enforced via the `security_gate` annotation; references exit code 2 and the belt-and-suspenders prose.

standard/README.md: the state-machine summary section gains a sentence noting that as of 0.7.1 the three transitions out of automated-gates are annotated `security_gate: true` and require `security_review_verdict === 'pass'` when `security_class === 'high'`; references validators/security-gate.ts.

site/src/content/guide/05-delivery.mdx: a short subsection added describing the security_gate / resets_security_verdict annotations and how they constrain the existing topology (no new states, only preconditions on three edges). Cross-reference 07-agents.mdx and 08-gates.mdx where appropriate.

site/src/content/guide/07-agents.mdx: the Security Reviewer section gains a short subsection 'Mechanical enforcement (reference-impl 0.8.1+)' describing advance-status's classify-security writeback and exit-code-2 refusal path, and the belt-and-suspenders relationship with orchestrator prose. Reference the v0.8.0 dogfood lesson as motivation.
reference-impl/package.json `version` bumped from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1; `peerDependencies['@cloverleaf/standard']` bumped from ^0.7.0 to ^0.7.1.

reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md gets a new top entry `## 0.8.1 — 2026-05-26` with Changed/Added/Dependencies sections per the spec §7 narrative, naming each load-bearing surface (advance-status guard, classify-security writeback, verdict reset, set-task-field subcommand, security-review SKILL verdict writes, run SKILL refusal-and-recover prose, security-reviewer prompt verdict requirement, ^0.7.1 standard peer bump).

reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh gains (or already contains) a tagged scenario `flow2-dogfood-repro` whose script body reproduces the Flow 2 sequence end-to-end against a freshly-created temp repo and asserts the same recovery-path outcome captured in the CLV-107 Flow 2 integration test. Documented in a comment block at the top of the new scenario.
Final dual-suite green: `cd standard && npm run build && npm test` AND `cd reference-impl && npm run build && npm test` — both report zero failures.

Running `reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh flow2-dogfood-repro` exits 0 with a stdout line indicating the refusal observed AND the recovery sequence succeeded AND the task reached status='merged'.
acceptance_criteria: reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md head contains '## 0.8.1' AND the literal phrases 'classify-security writeback', 'set-task-field', 'exit code 2', and '@cloverleaf/standard.*\^0.7.1' (or a near-equivalent).
grep 'security_gate' standard/README.md returns at least one match; grep 'mechanically enforced' reference-impl/README.md returns at least one match.

site/src/content/guide/05-delivery.mdx contains a subsection mentioning `security_gate` and `resets_security_verdict`; site/src/content/guide/07-agents.mdx contains a subsection titled (or substantively named) 'Mechanical enforcement' mentioning advance-status exit code 2.

Running `bash reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh flow2-dogfood-repro` end-to-end exits 0; stdout/stderr together contain evidence of the refusal (exit 2) AND the eventual merge, matching the Flow 2 trail asserted by CLV-107.
